decoded.meaning: FWD{ op=READ, dst=<pair 3:1>, src=/reply-ep } - a chain of length one: its only element names the target on the receiving node, which applies the op with the same apply_op the NAME spelling reaches (RFC-0029 6 step 3). A bound terminus never write-creates.
decoded.note: 37 bytes, against 38 for the NAME spelling /sensor/temp of the same operation, and 4 bytes a hop more than the retired 7-byte label (5.2). The ACL verdict is the resolver's own gate at the dereferenced vertex - a generation match authorizes nothing (6.4).
